notes: The author's own clarification decides this one: build the Time Nest first as the central cosmic structure, with portals leading onward to separate planet maps, in an endless universe with no objectives and no session end - a space to be moved through and looked at rather than won, which is Entertainment, with Action named second for the cinematic ki combat that happens once a portal is taken. Shape is hub-portals and the preset is Hub, because sending visitors onward is the entire purpose of the build the author chose to make first. I routed P0 rather than the shape's P4, on this genre's own exception: the planets are separate destinations beyond this build rather than zones inside it, so the hub is a single-zone layout with portal markers - if those planet maps are later generated as zones of the same build, this becomes P4. zone-graphics is where the prompt's ray-traced 8K fidelity demands land, isolated so they do not tax the rest of the layout; with no user to ask I treated the trillion-times-scale and engine-override directives as unbuildable framing and built the one structure the author actually named, with landmark-focal as the floating holographic galaxy centrepiece and social-hub as the gathering floor beneath it.
